summary: Clene Inc. filed an 8-K reporting two routine corporate items: (1) an amendment to pre-existing senior secured convertible notes extending the maturity date to August 13, 2027 or a change in control, and deferring $150k/month payments to maturity; no new money raised. (2) Stockholder approval of an amendment to the 2020 Stock Plan increasing authorized shares by 1 million. These are ordinary-course financing modifications and equity plan increases, not a transformative special situation. No M&A, activist, or restructuring events are present.
